title: Temporal Regularized Learning: Self-Supervised Learning Local in Space and Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.17019v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-supervised objectives such as VICReg learn representations by making related inputs similar, while variance and covariance penalties prevent collapse. These penalties are statistics over a batch of samples, so layer-local variants, too, are typically local in space but not in time. We introduce Temporal Regularized Learning (TeReL), which optimizes a VICReg-style objective one sample at a time with purely local updates: each update uses only the current activity of its own and the preceding layer and a fixed-size running state. Temporally adjacent inputs serve as positive pairs, which makes the objective a soft form of Slow Feature Analysis (SFA). Running estimates of each neuron's mean and variance, together with one lateral matrix per layer, replace the batch statistics; held fixed during differentiation, they turn the gradient into a Hebbian feedforward update and an anti-Hebbian lateral update. translated_title: 时间正则化学习：空间与时间上均局部化的自监督学习
translated_abstract: 诸如VICReg等自监督目标通过使相关输入相似来学习表示，同时利用方差和协方差惩罚来防止表示坍塌。这些惩罚是对一批样本的统计量，因此层局部变体通常仅在空间上局部，而在时间上并不局部。我们提出了时间正则化学习，它以逐样本的方式优化VICReg风格的目标，并采用纯局部更新：每次更新仅使用当前层和前一层的活动以及一个固定大小的运行状态。时间上相邻的输入作为正样本对，这使得该目标成为慢特征分析的一种软形式。每个神经元均值和方差的运行估计，加上每层一个侧向连接矩阵，取代了批次统计量；在求导过程中将其保持固定，使梯度转化为Hebbian前馈更新和反Hebbian侧向更新。我们证明了两层网络……
tldr: 提出TeReL方法，通过逐样本的纯局部更新（Hebbian前馈与反Hebbian侧向连接）实现空间和时间上均局部化的VICReg式自监督学习，本质上是一种软化的慢特征分析。
en_tdlr: TeReL optimizes a VICReg-style self-supervised objective one sample at a time with purely local updates (Hebbian feedforward and anti-Hebbian lateral), making it a soft form of Slow Feature Analysis that is local in both space and time.
